# betterado_pipeline_approvals (Data Source)

Lists pipeline approvals for a given pipeline run in Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_pipeline_approvals" "example" {
  project_id      = "my-project"
  pipeline_run_id = "42"
}

output "approvals" {
  value = data.betterado_pipeline_approvals.example.approvals
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_run_id` (String) Integer run ID as a string. The data source lists all pending approvals for this run.
- `project_id` (String) The ID or name of the Azure DevOps project.

### Read-Only

- `approvals` (List of Object) List of approvals associated with the pipeline run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approvals))
- `id` (String) Computed ID set to `project_id/pipeline_run_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--approvals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approvals`

Read-Only:

- `approved_by_id` (String) The identity descriptor of the approver who made the decision.
- `comment` (String) Comment associated with the approval decision.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the approval.
- `instructions` (String) Instructions provided to the approver.
- `status` (String) The current status of the approval.
